Title: Chiropteran Marauder and Path of the Metamorphosis

Messages.Author: Tuomas Rinta
Messages.Body:
Does Path of the Metamorphosis enable you to play the superior version
of Chiropteran Marauder without having to burn the one pool for the
aggravated hand damage?

Tuomas Rinta

Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
Tuomas Rinta wrote:
:: Does Path of the Metamorphosis enable you to play the superior

:: version of Chiropteran Marauder without having to burn the one pool

(blood)
:: for the aggravated hand damage?

NO.
Path of Metamorphosis reduce by one the cost of blood of a card. The cost is
the number in a drop on the left. Any other "burn blood" requirement on a
card is not the cost of the combat card.

reyda

The Path of Metamorphosis
Unique Master. Put this card in play. Tzimisce burn one less blood
when playing cards that require Vicissitude.

Chiropteran Marauder
[VIC] This vampire can pay one blood to make the damage from his or
her hand strikes aggravated for the current round.

So paying blood is different from burning? That sounds a little
strange.

I'd rather say that the cost isn't paid "when playing cards...". The
card is played first, the blood is paid afterwards. Correct?

> The Path of Metamorphosis
> Unique Master. Put this card in play. Tzimisce burn one less blood
> when playing cards that require Vicissitude.
>
> Chiropteran Marauder
> [VIC] This vampire can pay one blood to make the damage from his or
> her hand strikes aggravated for the current round.
>
> So paying blood is different from burning? That sounds a little
> strange.

1) Card cost is different thant the cost of some effect.
Chiropteran Marauder's cost to play is 0. The superior allows the
vampire to pay 1 blood to get some effect. That 1 blood is not the
cost of playing the card, however.

2) Blood "paid" is burned, yes. Not all blood burned is burned to
pay some cost, however.

> I'd rather say that the cost isn't paid "when playing cards...". The
> card is played first, the blood is paid afterwards. Correct?

No. You pay the cost of the card in order to play the card.
